Pedicure Menu

♡ Basic Pedicure

Cash: $30  |  Card: $30.60

Relax in our massage chair while your feet soak in a soothing, fragrant spa bath. Enjoy nail trimming, shaping, grooming, warm towel wrap, relaxing foot massage, and your choice of polish.

♡ Callus Care Pedicure

Cash: $35  |  Card: $35.70

Includes our Basic Pedicure plus professional callus care with Callus Remover to soften and smooth dry, rough areas. Finished with Sugar Scrub exfoliation, warm towel wrap, relaxing foot massage, and your choice of polish.

♡ Spa Pedicure

Cash: $40  |  Card: $40.80

Enjoy professional callus care, Sugar Scrub exfoliation, essential oil massage, warm Paraffin Wax treatment, warm towel wrap, and your choice of polish.

♡ Jelly Spa Pedicure

Cash: $45  |  Card: $45.90

Relax in a soothing Jelly Spa soak while enjoying professional callus care, Sugar Scrub exfoliation, nourishing foot mask, lotion massage, warm towel wrap, and your choice of polish.

♡ Signature Spa Pedicure

Cash: $50  |  Card: $51.00

Experience an elevated pedicure featuring Warm Foot Steam Treatment, soothing salt soak, professional callus care, Sugar Scrub exfoliation, nourishing foot mask, massage candle treatment, hot stones, warm Paraffin Wax treatment, and your choice of polish.

♡ Volcano Pedicure

Cash: $60  |  Card: $61.20

Experience the ultimate spa experience with a soothing Volcano soak, brown sugar scrub, hydrating collagen foot mask, professional nail shaping, relaxing lotion and hot stone massage, nourishing massage candle treatment, Warm Foot Steam Treatment, and a warm herbal neck towel wrap. Finished with a luxurious paraffin wax treatment and your choice of polish.
